body: Avoid running the same habitat probes twice under identical seeds/artifact labels. `all_habitat_geometry_probes_summary` re-invokes every probe in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs:1342-1405`, even though those same probes are still standalone `#[test]`s at `:249`, `:521`, `:712`, `:900`, and `:1185`. `HarnessRun::artifact_dir` is derived only from `scenario_id`, `artifact_label`, and seed in `crates/tank_harness/src/lib.rs:624-640`, so under Rust's default parallel test execution the summary test and the corresponding individual test can race on the same temp directory and clobber failure artifacts.
